title: Learner 01 | Day 100: Citations, abstention, and conflicting sources
body:
## Goal

Validate cited chunk IDs and show uncertainty or conflicting source versions explicitly.

## Implementation contract

**File:** `src/learnforge/adapters/storage/grounded_answers.py`

**Method/unit:** `access_source_citation`

**Why here:** This changes or reads stored state: file/SQL/index/cache details and atomicity belong behind the storage boundary, separate from business rules.

**Inputs and expected outputs:** Invented citation is rejected; no evidence produces cannot-answer; conflicting dates are shown as a conflict.

**Boundaries:** Own the state/read/write only; do not duplicate calculations or presentation.

## Research hints

1. Research **Citations, abstention, and conflicting sources**. Which rule explains your named unit’s behavior?
2. Search `site:huggingface.co/docs Citations abstention and conflicting sources`; use [Hugging Face LLM course](https://huggingface.co/learn/llm-course/chapter1/1) for the relevant small section.
3. Predict one changed input/timing case, run it, and explain each changed value before applying the finding.

## Done

- [ ] Demonstrate this unit’s normal and boundary/failure cases in the working feature.
- [ ] Show the actual run and explain one changed case using concrete values.

**Question of the Day:** Why subtract the maximum before exponentiating softmax logits?

**Review with @GlidingScorpion:** run the named unit; show actual output and each relevant line’s purpose, before/after values and project contribution.
